sentences.en: There are trends in food much as there are trends in clothing.
sentences.zh: 食品领域和服装领域一样，也存在潮流趋势。

sentences.en: Interest in food fashions has risen rapidly since the birth of the smartphone when people first began taking photos of their food and instantly sharing them with their friends.
sentences.zh: 自智能手机问世以来，人们对美食时尚的兴趣迅速上升，因为人们开始拍摄自己的食物照片，并即时与朋友分享。

sentences.en: The food industry in the UK in particular is obsessed with finding and exploiting the next big food trend.
sentences.zh: 尤其是英国的食品行业，痴迷于寻找并利用下一个重大的食品潮流。

sentences.en: Marketeers aim to create a huge demand for a food item which was previously unknown or not needed.
sentences.zh: 营销人员旨在为一种此前鲜为人知或并不需要的食品制造巨大的需求。

sentences.en: One of the most effective ways of promoting a new food product is by using social media influencers as brand ambassadors In return for free samples man: y influencers will post content about a product although there are influencers with hundreds of thousands of followers who can command large fees for their services Companies which sell vegan produce were pioneers in being able to increase sales really quickly in this way.
sentences.zh: 推广一种新型食品最有效的方式之一，是利用社交媒体网红作为品牌大使；作为免费样品的回报，这些网红会发布有关该产品的相关内容；尽管如此，仍有一些拥有数十万粉丝的网红，能为其服务收取高额费用；销售纯素食产品的公司是最早通过这种方式快速提升销量的先行者。

sentences.en: For a food item to become really popular, it has to be readily available.
sentences.zh: 一种食品要想真正流行起来，必须易于获取。

sentences.en: So supermarkets have a role to play in creating a new food trend.
sentences.zh: 因此，超市在创造新的食品潮流方面也发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: They have dedicated teams closely following which new products or ingredients are trending on social media and are particularly interested in what well-known chefs are putting on their menus.
sentences.zh: 它们设有专门团队，密切关注哪些新产品或新食材正在社交媒体上走红，并尤其关注知名厨师们将其列入菜单的情况。

sentences.en: I'd like to look at a few examples of marketing campaigns which were really successful in launching a new fashion trend.
sentences.zh: 我想举几个营销活动的成功案例，这些活动成功地推出了新的食品潮流。

sentences.en: Starting in the 1990s with the avocado.
sentences.zh: 首先从20世纪90年代的牛油果说起。

sentences.en: A British PR company was hired to raise its profile and stimulate demand.
sentences.zh: 一家英国公关公司受雇提升牛油果的知名度并刺激市场需求。

sentences.en: They paid for a group of journalists to travel out to South Africa to meet avocado farmers.
sentences.zh: 该公司出资安排一群记者前往南非，拜访牛油果种植农户。

sentences.en: Articles written following this visit helped to educate the British public about the avocado, which at this time was certainly not the daily staple it's since become.
sentences.zh: 此次访问后撰写的报道帮助英国公众了解了牛油果——当时它远非如今这般成为日常必备品。

sentences.en: Advertisements were designed to promote the avocado as a superfood, rich in nutrients and therefore beneficial for health.
sentences.zh: 广告设计将牛油果宣传为富含营养的超级食品，因而有益健康。

sentences.en: Avocados became hugely fashionable, and within a few years UK avocado sales had grown from £13 million annually to around £150 million, making it one of the most successful fresh produce campaigns in UK history.
sentences.zh: 牛油果迅速风靡一时，短短几年内，英国牛油果年销售额便从1300万英镑飙升至约1.5亿英镑，使其成为英国历史上最成功的生鲜产品营销活动之一。

sentences.en: Oat milk is a recent example of a new product which became fashionable very quickly.
sentences.zh: 燕麦奶是近期一个迅速走红的新产品实例。

sentences.en: Now there are man: y brands available but one company which had early success was the Swedish brand Oatly They attracted a lot of attention with a media campaign which used provocation as a way of getting their message across effectively.
sentences.zh: 如今市面上已有众多品牌，但早期取得成功的一家公司是瑞典品牌Oatly；他们通过一场以挑衅为策略的媒体宣传活动吸引了大量关注，从而高效传达了品牌信息。

sentences.en: The fact that this campaign aggravated competitors producing milk from dairy cows was seen as a plus, as it helped to make oat milk seem cool.
sentences.zh: 这场宣传活动激怒了以奶牛产奶为原料的竞争品牌，这一事实反而被视为优势，因为它让燕麦奶显得更酷。

sentences.en: In the USA, the brand decided against a big retail launch in favour of getting the product into coffee chains, which removed the need for a big advertising budget.
sentences.zh: 在美国，该品牌决定不采取大规模零售渠道首发策略，而是选择先进入咖啡连锁店，从而避免了巨额广告预算的投入。

sentences.en: This proved far more effective than offering samples in supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 实践证明，此举比在超市提供试吃样品要有效得多。

sentences.en: Oat milk had an advantage over other alternative milk products, such as almond milk.
sentences.zh: 燕麦奶相比其他植物奶（例如杏仁奶）具有优势。

sentences.en: Man: y consumers prefer it because it has less of an impact on the environment.
sentences.zh: 男：消费者更青睐它，是因为它对环境的影响更小。

sentences.en: It requires significantly less water to produce than other alternative milk products and it also has a relatively low carbon footprint.
sentences.zh: 与其它植物奶相比，燕麦奶的生产所需用水量显著减少，且其碳足迹也相对较低。

sentences.en: Norwegian scray, a rarely available seasonal fish delicacy, otherwise known as Arctic cod, is now found on the menus of Michelin - starred restaurants throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: 挪威斯克雷鱼是一种极为稀有、仅在特定季节捕获的珍馐鱼类，亦称北极鳕鱼，如今已出现在欧洲多家米其林星级餐厅的菜单上。

sentences.en: The demand for Skre has been used by a food marketing agency to build the reputation of Norway's fisheries in general.
sentences.zh: 斯克雷鱼日益增长的需求已被一家食品营销机构用以整体提升挪威渔业的声誉。

sentences.en: Marketing surveys have shown that a significant number of shoppers now associate Norway with excellent seafood.
sentences.zh: 市场营销调查显示，目前有相当数量的购物者已将挪威与优质海产品联系在一起。

sentences.en: Food trends can be considered a good thing in some ways, as they can benefit farmers and food producers enormously.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，食品潮流可被视为一件好事，因为它能极大惠及农民和食品生产商。

sentences.en: The public can also be encouraged to buy things which are more sustainably produced.
sentences.zh: 公众亦可被鼓励购买那些以更可持续方式生产的产品。

sentences.en: But ethical concerns have been raised about the effects a surge in demand can cause.
sentences.zh: 但需求激增所引发的种种影响，已引发诸多伦理方面的担忧。

sentences.en: Quinoa is a classic example.
sentences.zh: 藜麦便是一个典型例子。

sentences.en: This plant is native to Peru and when demand peaked some years ago the price soared making it unaffordable for local people.
sentences.zh: 这种植物原产于秘鲁；数年前需求达到高峰时，其价格飙升，致使当地民众无力负担。

sentences.en: While the popularity of quinoa has benefited farmers financially there have been other negative consequences.
sentences.zh: 尽管藜麦走红为农民带来了可观的经济收益，却也带来了一系列负面后果。

sentences.en: As demand grew, farmers began working the land all year round in order to produce more quinoa.
sentences.zh: 随着需求增长，农民开始全年无休地耕作土地，以扩大藜麦产量。

sentences.en: One issue has been that the fertility of the soil decreased dramatically. which could potentially lead to desertification in some areas.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是土壤肥力急剧下降，这在某些地区甚至可能引发荒漠化。

sentences.en: Another example would be the case of...
sentences.zh: 另一个例子则是……
